prompt.task: Modify the parent rule once. Keep Tour unless public weighted risk gain and penalized advantage are positive.

example.mechanism: Use public evidence and retain Tour unless net advantage is positive.

prompt.formula: rho=clip(sum(nonnegative source_weight*freshness*known existing component),0,4); G=mean(weight*rho*(F_original-F_candidate)/deadline) over ALL owned tasks. advantage=G-travel_penalty*max(delta_travel/300s,0)-deadline_penalty*max(delta_mean_squared_age_ratio,0). Change only if G>1e-9 and advantage>margin+1e-9. Otherwise original. Safe pool external.
prompt.source_semantics: direct=qualified or telemetry own signal; model=frozen CVAE own temperature; power=public supply/demand proxy; cross=same-pod thermal proxy. Unknown null is not normal and is excluded, not calibrated probability. Source/time belong to each component. No positive qualified alarm prerequisite.
prompt.freshness_semantics: flat=1 for known components; linear300=max(0,1-age/300s). Costs cannot be negative. Existing physics thresholds and safety cannot change.
prompt.feedback_label: OFFLINE SIMULATION DEVELOPMENT only: true single-intervention paired branches share prefix/state then correctly restore Tour. Not oracle actions or generalization data. Future observations never backfilled.

prompt.parent_selection: Child must Pareto-dominate parent on mean missed/wait/travel and not be dominated by T/R; otherwise keep parent and archive tradeoff. Formal default remains T unless strict qualification. Healthy wait is null, not zero.
prompt.instruction: Return the exact JSON object with all six fields. source_weights is an object, mechanism a string <=12 English words. Do not copy the unchanged example or any evaluated rule. No markdown, additional keys or code. No repair is applied.
prompt.provenance_note: Origin=[group_index,time_s,source_index,contributors]. Contributors=[pod,local_rack_indices,group,time]; grouped equal origins preserve all members. Age=paired current time minus origin time; task direct age separate.5-significant-digit display; deltas calculated before rounding and Pareto uses full precision.
prompt.numeric_representation: All equivalent JSON number spellings share identity; -0.0 and0.0 are the same parameter, never a new edit.
